title: HB1541 (2019-2020 Regular): Prohibiting the possession and acquisition of weapons by persons convicted of certain criminal offenses or subject to certain no-contact orders, protection orders, or restraining orders.

provenance.fetched_by: Open States public data converted to LegiScan layout (gun-policy Stage 5, Washington); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Washington Legislature text (Introduced, https://lawfilesext.leg.wa.gov/Biennium/2019-20/Htm/Bills/House%20Bills/1541.htm, downloaded directly)
provenance.note: Introduced (HTML, marks visible; 2019 session). Strikes the 'intimate partner' wording and the definition of 'intimate partner' (old subsection (8)) so the order-based ban applies to any protected person. Items are renumbered ((iv) to (v), etc.). Secs. 3-9 only change cross-references (juvenile possession, juvenile sentencing standards, health-record release) to the renumbered item (vi); not quoted. The (3) clause in RCW 9.41.800 ends with 'the court shall:' continuing existing law not reprinted here.
